comments.author: Mr.Grandenigo
comments.body:
Its kind of my secret but oh well, its not like it something truly special :)
Go straight west from Bergen, sail in a straight line just so far that you will still be able to see the town in the horizon (it must not fade away), then lower the sails and FISH ahoy (8-9/10 salmon catch)! :)
Note that with low maritime level and/no caution you will be ambushed by Norwegian pirate fleet, which is not strong, but can kill you if you go afk, which can be annoying.
I hope it helps you!

comments.author: Schipper
comments.body:
I tested the point west of Bergen and the one off Scandinavia West (landing point north of Bergen). Fishing R12.

The point west of Bergen was ok, but along with a good amount of salmon and cod I also got herring and trash rockfish. I tried several spots in the general area so I might have been slightly off the sweet spot.

The point just off Scandinavia West gave me 80-90% salmon and a small amount of herring. Coords 345,1690.
